prompt: Build me a contact form with fields for name, email, and message. Include validation -- name and email are required, email must be valid. Show a submit button that shows loading state while submitting.
assertions: Uses native events: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value, NOT e.detail.value or CustomEvent
Uses wa-stack or wa-gap utility classes for vertical layout
Has required prop on name and email inputs
Uses type='email' on the email Input
Has loading prop on submit Button during async submission
Wraps fields in a <form> element (not just a div)
